title: Bravariumcraft:Reforged
description: highly modded vanilla esc pack with emphasis on exploration and base building
body:
This pack overhaulls every aspect of the game while maintaining a vanilla esc style this pack is intended for multiplayer but can also be played singleplayer you should allocate about 5000mb of ram and add essential mod for multiplayer for the optimal experience,

I would also suggest you add these mods for the optimal experience:
Curseforge:
ends phantasm,
stay true resource pack,
umbral skies,
libary ferret,
born in chaos,
relics,
relics alex mobs compat,
bettervillage,
savage ender dragon,
smooth chunk save,
cuboard,
better fps and render distance,
the twilight forest ,
twilight flavours and delight,
